item.title: Thoughts on IT Competition, Inspired by Google Wave
item.author: Author
item.description: Today I took my wife out for DQ, and then while keeping her company over a bowl of Ajisen ramen I drank some iced lemon water. The result was that the moment I got home I made a beeline for the toilet. Of course I didn’t forget to bring a magazine — we have a pile of back issues at home, so I grabbed a copy of CBN Weekly at random, no idea which issue it was. Flipping through it, being an IT guy, IT is naturally what interests me most, so the article about Google Wave was the first thing I read.
